"When will ​The Wall Street Journal start calling Artificial Intelligence (AI), a very ​bad and inaccurate name, ​SI (Super Intelligence), the name which ‌virtually ⁠everyone else is using, or soon will be," Trump said in a ​post on ​Truth ⁠Social.

item.title: Trump Wants to Ban Use of the Term 'Artificial Intelligence' and 'AI'
item.description:
# Trump Says ‘Artificial Intelligence’ Is ‘a Very Bad and Inaccurate Name,’ and That He Wants to Officially Ban the Term ‘AI’ ### [Todd Spangler](https://variety.com/author/todd-spangler/) #### Latest President [Donald Trump](https://variety.com/t/donald-trump/) doesn’t like the term “ [artificial intelligence](https://variety.com/t/artificial-intelligence/)” — which was coined more than 70 years ago and is widely used by computer scientists and the tech industry — and says he wants to ban the usage of “AI” in favor of “super intelligence.”
## Related Stories ### [Apple TV's 'Guilty Creatures' Series Adds Brian d’Arcy James, Reed Birney, Gus Birney (EXCLUSIVE)](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/apple-tv-guilty-creatures-brian-darcy-james-reed-gus-birney-1236932081/) “When will The Wall Street Journal start calling Artificial Intelligence (AI), a very bad and inaccurate name, SI (Super Intelligence), the name which virtually everyone else is using, or soon will be,” Trump wrote. “In short order, we will be officially BANNING the term, ‘AI/Artificial Intelligence,’ in all relevant documents, and everything else, due to its inaccuracy.
“It is therefore the policy of my Administration that, to the maximum extent permitted by law, the executive branch shall use the terms ‘Super Intelligence’ and ‘SI’ in place of ‘Artificial Intelligence’ and ‘AI’ and will not acknowledge the usage of ‘Artificial Intelligence’ and ‘AI’ in any applicable setting.”
Most AI companies, including Anthropic and OpenAI, have continued to use “artificial intelligence” and “AI” to describe themselves.

item.title: Trump Says He Will Ban Term ‘Artificial Intelligence’ In Latest Push For ‘Super Intelligence’
item.description:
# Trump Vows To Ban Term ‘Artificial Intelligence’ ## Topline President Donald Trump in a Truth Social [post](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117513761542349273) on Tuesday said he will soon ban the term “artificial intelligence” in “all relevant documents” and “everything else,” marking his latest push to replace it with his preferred term, “super intelligence.”
## Key Facts The post questioned why The Wall Street Journal continues to use the term “artificial intelligence,” which he dubbed “a very bad and inaccurate name” instead of “Super Intelligence.”
In Tuesday’s post, Trump said “everyone else is using, or soon will be” using the term SI instead of AI—while federal agencies and government databases use the term and Elon Musk has indicated he will rebrand SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI, major national outlets still use AI, and it is listed as the proper term in The Associated Press Stylebook.
## KEY BACKGROUND It asserted that the executive branch won’t “acknowledge the usage of ‘Artificial Intelligence’ and ‘AI’ in any applicable setting” moving forward, and set a 60-day timeline for Michael Kratsios, Trump’s science and technology advisor, to determine the extent to which the new term will “supersede the existing statutory definition of ‘artificial intelligence’.”
## TANGENT Trump’s dislike of the term “artificial intelligence” dates back to July 2025, when he [said](https://www.poynter.org/fact-checking/2026/why-did-trump-rename-ai-super-intelligence/) “around the globe, everyone is talking about artificial intelligence. When he [addressed](https://transcripts.un.org/en/asset/k17/k17s3dutob) the United Nations General Assembly later in September, he said he believes “artificial intelligence” comes off as “fake intelligence,” and U.S. documents “and hopefully the world’s” will now use SI. He then [met](https://www.forbes.com/sites/saradorn/2026/09/30/white-house-releases-accord-between-billionaire-ai-execs-heres-what-it-says/?streamIndex=0) with the billionaires heading AI companies at the end of September to discuss and sign what he called a “morally binding agreement,” and the accord that came from it was dubbed the “White House Accord on Super Intelligence.”

item.title: Trump says he is going to ban everyone from using the phrase ‘artificial intelligence’
item.description:
## Top Stories: ![Trump says he is going to ban everyone from using the phrase ‘artificial intelligence’](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/a0616d0733fd7b474d734ceb8f3ed7967c129577178d4cc97f85ca8e1525f1d9/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w976%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_independent_635%2F8b2ff870b13140dd925b27fa65251b7a.jpg)
Trump says he is going to ban everyone from using the phrase ‘artificial intelligence’
President [Donald Trump](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-midterms-texas-live-updates-b3074205.html) has promised to ban everyone from using the phrase "artificial intelligence" as he continues to promote a more favorable term — "super intelligence."
"When will The Wall Street Journal start calling Artificial Intelligence (AI), a very bad and inaccurate name, SI (Super Intelligence), the name which virtually everyone else is using, or soon will be.
"In short order, we will be officially BANNING the term, 'AI/Artificial Intelligence,' in all relevant documents, and everything else, due to its inaccuracy," Trump [wrote](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117513761542349273) on Truth Social Tuesday afternoon.
![President Donald Trump has promised to ban everyone from using the phrase 'artificial intelligence' as he continues to promote a more favorable term — 'super intelligence' (AFP via Getty Images)](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/c94931398980d218116e658c9512fa4375cdd55abcd655a28328aae361a170a7/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_independent_635%2Fe36beb0b79ea7c243f2cc1c2a9e4a97e.jpg)
President Donald Trump has promised to ban everyone from using the phrase 'artificial intelligence' as he continues to promote a more favorable term — 'super intelligence' (AFP via Getty Images)
Earlier this month, Trump [bizarrely stated](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-ai-super-intelligence-the-enemy-b3063681.html) in another Truth Social post that the White House considers anyone who uses the term "artificial intelligence" over "super intelligence" to be "THE ENEMY!"
Trump has already directed the federal government to use the term "super intelligence" in place of "artificial intelligence."
The term "artificial intelligence" was coined in 1955 by Stanford University emeritus professor John McCarthy, who described it as "the science and engineering of making intelligent machines."
![Earlier this month, Trump bizarrely stated in another Truth Social post that the White House considers anyone who uses the term 'artificial intelligence' over 'super intelligence' to be 'THE ENEMY!' (Getty Images)](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/92e92d11189148a6f098a7f3ae16563e8d727bb78e399300e7a06d0fe09225e4/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_independent_635%2Fb84417d3baaaf5006d5e031988932136.jpg)
Earlier this month, Trump bizarrely stated in another Truth Social post that the White House considers anyone who uses the term 'artificial intelligence' over 'super intelligence' to be 'THE ENEMY!'
Just 23 percent of Americans believe Trump has handled artificial intelligence well, while 57 percent say he's handled the issue poorly, according to a [survey](https://www.umass.edu/poll/about/reports/2026-09-national-public-opinion-poll-2) from the University of Massachusetts Amherst published last month.
